name: the boundaries that are admitted
description: Every bound from the inclusive side, in one scenario: `max_power_mw` exactly at the 10 000 cap, `energy_capacity_mwh` at 100 000, `round_trip_efficiency` exactly at the 0.50 floor, an initial state of charge exactly at `max_state_of_charge`, `max_charge_mw` exactly at `max_power_mw`, a shift exactly at the flat baseline, `L` at 8, a recovery time at 24 and `brl_per_mwh` exactly at 10 000. A cap read as `>=` rather than `>` fails here rather than in production.
